t: This is Pinehurst Court, a portered Victorian mansion block at 1 to 9 Colville Gardens, near Portobello Market. It was built in the 1870s by the builder George Frederick Tippett, who developed much of the old St Quintin Estate here. The houses were first family homes, then from the 1880s were divided into flats. By 1935 the area was described as a largely slum area. Gentrification in the 1980s and 1990s greatly improved the building, and it now sits in one of London's most fashionable neighbourhoods.
